# E C Dunn Ltd

> Specialist ceilings and partitions contractor. 25+ years trading. London, Essex, and the wider South East of England. Schools, healthcare, heritage, and commercial fit-outs.

E C Dunn Ltd (est. 2001) is a UK trade contractor specialising in suspended ceilings, drylining, metal-frame (MF) ceilings, fire-rated systems, and heritage ceiling restoration. Core coverage is London and Essex with regular work across the South East of England. The business has completed 500+ projects, with particular depth in schools (40+ delivered), NHS healthcare facilities, and period/listed-building restoration. Compliance and accreditation cover BBA certification, DfE approval, HTM compliance for healthcare, and Cat A fire-rating work. Preferred material suppliers include Armstrong, Rockfon, and Knauf.

## Company facts

- Trading name: E C Dunn Ltd
- Established: 2001 (25+ years trading)
- Base: Orsett / Hornchurch area, Essex, UK
- Primary services: suspended ceilings, MF ceilings, metal stud partitions, drylining, fire-rated systems, heritage restoration
- Target sectors: schools and education, hospitals and healthcare (NHS), heritage and listed buildings, commercial fit-outs, restaurants and hospitality
- Coverage: London, Essex, wider South East England
- Compliance: BBA certified, DfE approved, HTM compliant, Cat A fire-rated, acoustic-rated, antibacterial-rated systems
- Key suppliers: Armstrong, Rockfon, Knauf
